about: The SovereignWebsite organisation's repositories, as code. org-apply creates any that are missing and keeps their settings as written here. It never deletes, transfers, archives or makes private (policy/abp.json). Each site repository is seeded with the files in its seed/ folder (only files that are missing are added), Pages on from a workflow on dev, and its apex domain. Every repository gives the teams in defaults.teams their permission (the agents' team gets push, never admin).
